passphoto.name: PassPhoto
passphoto.desc: PassPhoto is completely free to use. Every photo feature is included. Optional tips support development and unlock nothing. Take or choose a photo, pick your document, and PassPhoto crops it to that document’s official rules for 45 countries and areas, plus the international ICAO standard. Faces are never retouched. The photo check runs on your iPhone or with Apple’s Private Cloud Compute.
shots: PassPhoto on iPhone with a passport portrait fitted to the head and eye guides
A 4 by 6 inch print sheet with two copies of the photo and cut marks
steps: Choose from 63 documents across 45 countries and areas, each with its official rules and source.
The guided camera tells you when everything lines up.
Review the photo against the document rules, then save it or make a 4×6 print sheet.

billsplit.name: BillSplit
billsplit.desc: Take a photo of the receipt and it scans the items, tax and total. Split the bill item by item. Assign each item, share tax and tip proportionally, and see what everyone owes. It saves profiles, so similar bills are matched automatically and split the way you chose. It uses Apple Intelligence with Private Cloud Compute, which keeps no data. Free to use, secure and private. BillSplit does not transfer bill payments or send payment requests. Optional support tips use Apple’s in-app purchase system.
shots: BillSplit on iPhone showing a receipt, item assignments, shared tax and tip, and the final total
Sample restaurant receipt with two dishes, tax, tip and a $38.71 total
steps: Take a photo of the receipt. It scans the items, tax and total.
Choose who had each item, including shared plates.
See each person's share of the items, tax and tip.
